title: Lost property at the museum
passage:
To: Visitor services
Subject: Blue bag left on Saturday

I visited the science museum on Saturday afternoon and may have left a small blue bag in the second-floor reading area. It contains a notebook with a green cover and a pair of glasses. I still have my wallet and phone, so those are not in the bag.

I cannot return to the museum before Wednesday because I am working out of town. If the bag has been found, please let me know whether a colleague can collect it on my behalf. I can provide a signed authorization and a description of the notebook’s first page.

Please contact me by email during the day; I may not be able to answer calls while working.
Leah

收件者：遊客服務處
主旨：星期六遺留的藍色袋子

我星期六下午參觀科學博物館，可能把一個小藍袋留在二樓閱讀區。袋內有綠色封面的筆記本和一副眼鏡。錢包及手機仍在我身上，所以不在袋中。

我正在外地工作，星期三前無法回博物館。如果找到袋子，請告訴我能否由同事代領。我可以提供簽署的授權書，以及筆記本第一頁的內容描述。

白天請以電子郵件聯絡；工作時可能無法接電話。
Leah
